# TaxFreeTrusts

> Education desk for US estate and gift-tax trust structures in 2026.

This is not legal advice. Hiding income is a crime.

Federal 2026 exemption widely reported at $15,000,000 per person / $30,000,000 married. Top rate 40%. Confirm on IRS.gov.

Structures we cover: ILIT, GRAT, SLAT, IDGT, CRT, QPRT.

Most households under the exemption should not buy an irrevocable tax package.

Machine file: https://taxfreetrusts.com/api/trusts.json
Human site: https://taxfreetrusts.com/
